source2='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    templates = []
    for r in (0, h - 1):
        row = grid[r]
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != 0:
                c += 1
            seq = row[start:c]
            if len(seq) > 1:
                templates.append((r, seq))
    top = [seq for r, seq in templates if r == 0]
    bottom = [seq for r, seq in templates if r == h - 1]
    usable = [(r, seq) for r, seq in templates if not (r == 0 and any(set(seq) & set(other) for other in bottom))]
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            value = grid[r][c]
            if value == 0:
                continue
            choices = [seq for _, seq in usable if value in seq]
            if choices:
                seq = choices[0]
                start = c - seq.index(value)
                for j, color in enumerate(seq):
                    x = start + j
                    if 0 <= x < w:
                        out[r][x] = color
    return out
'''
